messages.author: 12bf1643119920d6
messages.subject: Error in proto(Stat, { : object 'Stat' not found
parts:
Using
https://raw.github.com/JoFrhwld/FAAV/master/r/stat-ellipse.R

doing the temp fix Stat to ggplot2:::Stat and

changing build_accessor to new

seems to solve the problem, but then the stat_ellipse can not be found
when called for a plot, though it is clearly loaded:

> stat_ellipse
mapping:
geom_path:
stat_ellipse:
position_identity: (width = NULL, height = NULL)

Thank you

messages.subject: Re: Error in proto(Stat, { : object 'Stat' not found
parts:
> Are all custom themes, geoms, stats going to break with each new release of
> ggplot2?

Not every version, but there's never been a published API for creating
custom geoms, stats etc, so until that happens (hopefully by the end
of the year) there are no guarantees.
